items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There's a white bass player here, Sherwood Maginapain, pretty good player. You've probably seen him someplace.

ctx.x: It's re-strung. It's strung just the opposite way. You string it up. It's strung for me just as a right hand man would have his strung from him, but it's in the reverse order.
There's a white bass player here, Sherwood Maginapain, pretty good player. You've probably seen him someplace. He plays left handed, but he doesn't bother to re-string his. He plays on...
Just like a right hand man would string his.
